title: Profile
name_help: People you talk to see this name. A nickname is fine.
signed_out_body: With an account you can save your pets' profiles, get alerts and talk to people who have seen your pet.
phone_help: We never show your number publicly. We only show it in a confirmed conversation, if you choose that when reporting.
phone_invalid: Enter a phone number, for example 041 123 456.
sign_out_body: Reports you made on this device stay manageable from it.
sign_out_remove_links: Also remove the links for managing reports from this device
offline_body: We keep reports near you and their photos on this phone, so you can see them offline too.
offline_mobile_photos: Use mobile data for offline photos
offline_mobile_photos_help: When this is off, we download photos over Wi-Fi only.
offline_clear_body: We delete the saved reports near you and their photos from this phone. Reports waiting to be sent stay.
